svg.aria-label: Book T's four court figures beside the Rider-Waite-Smith Swords courts: mounted King printed as Knight; enthroned Queen; Prince in a chariot printed as King, where Waite's King sits on a throne; standing Princess printed as Knave, Waite's Page.
